manual.ores.line2: {0}§lBauxite Ore§r can be found in the world between layers {1} and {2}, and requires a pickaxe or tool of stone or better to harvest.{3}
manual.ores.line3: The raw ore will smelt into aluminium ingots, which are an integral part of high-voltage architecture.
manual.ores.line4: {0}§lLead Ore§r can be found in the world between layers {1} and {2}, and requires a pickaxe or tool of iron or better to harvest.{3}
manual.ores.line5: The raw ore will smelt into lead ingots, which are used in creating early accumulators, bullets, and industrial dyes.
manual.ores.line6: {0}§lSilver Ore§r can be found in the world between layers {1} and {2}, and requires a pickaxe or tool of iron or better to harvest.{3}
manual.ores.line7: The raw ore will smelt into silver ingots, which can be used in mirrors or alloyed with gold to create electrum, a far more effective conductor.
manual.ores.line8: {0}§lNickel Ore§r can be found in the world between layers {1} and {2}, but more abundantly below {3}. It requires a pickaxe or tool of iron or better to harvest.{4}
manual.ores.line9: The raw ore will smelt into nickel ingots, which can be used in accumulators, or  alloyed with copper to create constantan, for use in {0}Thermoelectric Generators{1}.
manual.ores.line10: {0}§lUranium Ore§r can be found in the world between layers {1} and {2}, and requires a pickaxe or tool of iron or better to harvest.{3}
manual.ores.line11: The raw ore will smelt into uranium ingots, but there are few uses for the metal. Uranium blocks can serve as heat sources for the {0}Thermoelectric Generator{1}, and the metal will be used in future endeavours.
